k:嘲.mnemonic: Every morning (朝) the rooster's mouth (口) opens wide to jeer at you for still being in bed. Ridicule (mock, insult).

k:劾.mnemonic: A person (人) who misused power (力) is called before the assembly and formally blamed in front of everyone. Censure (criminal investigation).

k:禍.mnemonic: Facing (向) the altar (礻), the villagers beg the gods to turn away the flood that has already swallowed half their houses. Calamity (misfortune, evil, curse).

k:捻.mnemonic: While making a wish (念), your fingers (扌) turn the ring round and round on your hand. Twirl (twist, play with).

k:礁.mnemonic: Stone (石) lying just under the waves, black as char (焦), waiting to scrape the bottom out of a passing ship. Reef (sunken rock).

k:娯.mnemonic: Put on fins (ハ) and splash about in the likeness (如) of a fish: an afternoon at the pool with no purpose but fun. Recreation (pleasure).

k:踪.mnemonic: The followers of a religion (宗) have moved on, but each pilgrim's leg (足) left a print in the mud. Follow the tracks to learn where they went. Remains (clue, footprint).

k:凸.mnemonic: Turn a pit (凵) upside down and set it on top of a hood (冂): now the middle sticks up above the edges. Convex (beetle brow, uneven).
k:凸.hint: A block bulging in the middle.

k:栓.mnemonic: The king (王) whittles a tree (木) branch into a stopper shaped like a little hat (𠆢) and pushes it into his wine barrel. Plug (bolt, cork, bung).
k:栓.hint: A wooden stopper in the barrel.

k:鋳.mnemonic: Monks pour molten gold (金) into a huge clay mould and wait for it to cool: the new bell for the temple (寺). Casting (mint).

k:租.mnemonic: The farmer hands over a sack of grain (禾), and moreover (且) another, stacked high on the collector's shelves. Tariff (crop tax, borrowing).
k:租.hint: Sacks stacked on the collector's shelves.

k:厘.mnemonic: Under an overhang (厂) in your hometown (里) you find the smallest coin ever minted there, worth a tenth of almost nothing. Rin.

k:肘.mnemonic: Take a measurement (寸) halfway along the arm: there is the joint where it folds, sore after a month (月) of leaning on the desk. Elbow (arm).

k:惧.mnemonic: Your heartbeat (忄) thuds as an eye (目) opens in the dark and stares straight at you. Dread (fear, be afraid of).

k:濯.mnemonic: A muddy turkey (隹) is scrubbed with a broom (ヨ) and rinsed with a tsunami (氵) of water until its feathers come up white. Laundry (wash, pour on, rinse).

k:丙.mnemonic: One (一) ticket punched and you are inside (内), but only just: the hard bench at the very back, two grades below the good seats. Third class (3rd, 3rd calendar sign).
k:丙.hint: The hard bench at the back.

k:耗.mnemonic: A samurai (士) forced to pull a plow (耒) wears through his fur (毛) coat. Every row rubs away a little more until it is nearly bald. Decrease.

k:瘍.mnemonic: It was easy (易) to ignore the little bump, but now it has puffed up and put you in a sickbed (疒). Swelling (boil, tumor).

k:瞭.mnemonic: On a bright day (日), from the big (大) tower, you can see the whole prefecture (県) with every roof and road sharp. Clear.
k:瞭.hint: Every rooftop sharp from the tower.

k:槽.mnemonic: The office (曹) has one luxury: a huge tub built of tree (木) staves, where the clerks soak after work. Vat (tub, tank).
k:槽.hint: Clerks soaking in a wooden tub.

k:弐.mnemonic: Three (三) lines were written, but a peg (弋) pins one of them down so that it cannot be counted. That leaves two. II (two, second).

k:畏.mnemonic: A scarecrow in the rice field (田) wears a dead man's garment (衣). At dusk the villagers bow as they pass, not quite sure it is only straw. Awe (fear, reverence, majestic).
k:畏.hint: Bowing to a scarecrow at dusk.

k:嗅.mnemonic: A dog (犬) finds something stinking (臭), shuts its mouth (口) and puts its nose to work instead. Smell (sniff, scent).

k:堆.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) scratches soil (土) into a heap, then stands on top of the mound to look taller. Piled high.

k:腺.mnemonic: A tiny spring (泉) inside the body that wells up on its own schedule, month (月) after month, releasing sweat, tears or hormones. Gland.
k:腺.hint: A tiny well inside the body.

k:嘱.mnemonic: The bureau (局) seals each letter with a paw print (禸) and hands it to a trusted runner to carry. Send a message (entrust, request).
k:嘱.hint: A sealed letter and a runner.

k:慄.mnemonic: A wind from the west (西) shakes the tree (木), and your heartbeat (忄) shakes with it: something is out there. Shudder (fear).
k:慄.hint: Branches shake, and so do you.

k:臆.mnemonic: He has had the idea (意) for a month (月) but never dares to say it aloud in the meeting. Timidity (heart, mind, fear).

k:迭.mnemonic: An arrow (矢) sign on the path (辶) sends the old cow (牛) off to a new field and brings another to take her place. Transfer (alternation).

k:濫.mnemonic: Nobody stayed to oversee (監) the bath taps, and now a tsunami (氵) pours over the rim and down the stairs. Far too much. Excessive (overflow, spread out).
